audience: companies that run a referral program on PartnerStack

useCases.title: Check which partners joined and what they submitted
useCases.text: List the partnerships of the program and read one to see its status and group. Then list the leads that partners submitted to your sales team.

useCases.title: Review open leads and the deals shared with you
useCases.text: List the leads and read one to see its amount, stage and fields. List the deals that resellers share with you.

useCases.title: Check rewards that are owed to partners
useCases.text: List the rewards and commissions owed to partners, with their amount and status. Read the transactions they came from.

useCases.title: Create a lead from a new introduction
useCases.text: Create a lead from a new introduction for your sales team. Use a unique external key, then read the lead back to check it.

useCases.title: Add a customer and check the details
useCases.text: Create a customer in your program, then read it back to check its email and name. The customer is not linked to a referral click.
